contact.name: International Relations Office
contact.evidence_quote: Once you register, your Coordinator needs to log in to Akademus system through their Institution account and assign you a nomination. Should you have any questions, please contact our International Relations Office at erasmus@asp.gda.pl

contacts.rung: International relations officer. The International Relations Office is the primary point of contact for Erasmus+ inquiries and student nominations.
